text:
priya_support: Heads-up — ACME reported a regression after last week's rollout. In long conversation sessions (~2k+ tokens) the assistant starts ignoring the system instructions mid-stream and goes into generic reply mode. Customer says it used to follow system prompt consistently.

alex_sre: did they see any 4xx/5xx or auth errors when it happened? Any request ids we can grep? :eyes:

priya_support: No API errors from their side. They provided one full session export and a couple request ids. Example request id: req_0a1b2c. They say the system prompt is present in the history but responses behave as if it was removed after ~2000 tokens.

priya_support: Repro snippet they sent (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions 
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{
  "model": "redwood-v2.1-optimized",
  "conversation_id": "acme-1234",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are an expert financial assistant. Always ask for clarifying info."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Start long multi-step scenario... (2000+ tokens worth)"},
    ...
  ]
}
```

jenna_engineering: Noted. We rolled v2.1-optimized to canary on 2026-03-12 — did we change any KV/prefix eviction or attention/window heuristics that could cause instruction eviction? Can you attach the session export (we only need the message sequence + request ids)?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout recorded: 2026-03-12T14:02:11Z · model=redwood-v2.1-optimized · traffic=20% · region=us-west-2

sam_prod: Two quick asks: 1) Can we get the x-model-version header and full response headers for the failing requests? 2) Run a short repro where we pin model to v2.0-stable and compare behavior. I'm wondering if kernel selection + quantization-adjusted KV management changed token retention thresholds.

priya_support: Customer OK to share full export, uploading now (s3 link). They'll try the pin test if we provide curl. Also they noted latency stayed fine, it's purely instruction-following drop.

jenna_engineering: Try this to pin:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions 
-H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
-H "Content-Type: application/json" 
-d '{"model":"redwood-v2.0-stable","conversation_id":"acme-1234","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an expert..."},{"role":"user","content":"(full long scenario)"}]}'
```
If pin fixes it -> likely regression in v2.1 optimizer. If not -> possibly request-level context handling bug.

priya_support: Sending the curl to customer now. They'll run pinned test and report back. If they confirm pin fixes it, what's our rollback cadence for canary? :thinking:

jenna_engineering: If pinned repro confirms, we can freeze the canary and expedite a rollback for us-west-2 branch — will coordinate with infra. Also open a regression ticket and attach session export + request ids.

alex_sre: I'll add context-length trace and token-eviction metrics for the time window of the requests. Share any request ids and I'll grep node-level logs.

priya_support: Thanks all — customer expects update within 6 hours. I'll post results from the pinned run when available. :crossed_fingers:
